page: Vultr vcg-a16-96c-960g-256vram is a server instance within the Dedicated Metal GPU family. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel CPU with 96 vCPUs under a shared allocation model. The system is equipped with 960.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 10.0 GB per vCPU.

Local storage consists of a 1700 GB NVMe SSD, providing high-speed read and write capabilities for local data. Although the instance belongs to the Dedicated Metal GPU family and lists NVIDIA as the GPU manufacturer, the active GPU count is specified as 0.0. The network configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The high memory density of 10.0 GB per core makes this configuration qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require dedicated CPU cores or active GPU acceleration. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, data warehousing, and memory-heavy enterprise applications.
